stanza: Sometimes they were comedic— or relentlessly horrifying
They were the foes of society, whether fighting the local sheriff, or a secret…
Frequently they mirrored our times: the gangster villains which rival real news…
Collectively, they are the components which have fueled nightmares for decades…
